# Template: copy into the APPLICATION repo as .github/workflows/deploy.yml.
# Keyless deploys via the OIDC role the module creates when github_repository is set.
#
# Repository variables (Settings > Secrets and variables > Actions > Variables):
#   AWS_REGION            e.g. us-east-1
#   AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN   module output: github_deploy_role_arn
#   ECR_REPOSITORY_URL    module output: ecr_repositories["web"]
#   ECS_CLUSTER           module output: ecs.cluster_name
#   ECS_SERVICE           module output: ecs.services["web"]
#   CONTAINER_NAME        the service key, e.g. web
name: Deploy to ECS

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  id-token: write # OIDC token for AWS
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: deploy-${{ vars.ECS_SERVICE }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  deploy:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: production

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Configure AWS credentials (OIDC)
        uses: aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials@v4
        with:
          role-to-assume: ${{ vars.AWS_DEPLOY_ROLE_ARN }}
          role-session-name: gha-${{ github.run_id }}
          aws-region: ${{ vars.AWS_REGION }}

      - name: Login to Amazon ECR
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecr-login@v2

      - name: Build and push image (tagged by commit SHA)
        id: build
        run: |
          IMAGE="${{ vars.ECR_REPOSITORY_URL }}:${GITHUB_SHA}"
          docker build -t "$IMAGE" .
          docker push "$IMAGE"
          echo "image=$IMAGE" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # Start from the latest revision Terraform registered (family = service name), so env vars, secrets,
      # roles and EFS changes made in Terraform ship with this deploy.
      - name: Fetch latest task definition
        run: |
          aws ecs describe-task-definition --task-definition "${{ vars.ECS_SERVICE }}" \
            --query taskDefinition > task-def.json

      - name: Render new image into task definition
        id: render
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecs-render-task-definition@v1
        with:
          task-definition: task-def.json
          container-name: ${{ vars.CONTAINER_NAME }}
          image: ${{ steps.build.outputs.image }}

      - name: Deploy (rolls back automatically via the ECS circuit breaker)
        uses: aws-actions/amazon-ecs-deploy-task-definition@v2
        with:
          task-definition: ${{ steps.render.outputs.task-definition }}
          cluster: ${{ vars.ECS_CLUSTER }}
          service: ${{ vars.ECS_SERVICE }}
          wait-for-service-stability: true
